sydneyfortner@ucsb.edu:
Hi team, Could you please review Sydney's feedback regarding the text entry issue outlined below? My comments are in italics, and Sydney's are in regular text. ---2. Autocorrect for Text Responses: All phone OS keyboards have autocorrect features that should work for text entry. Please let us know if our system disables it, and we will fix that. Currently, autocorrect is disabled in the app, despite users having the setting turned on. A fix would be lovely-- thank you! --- Thanks a lot. Best, Sara------
